title: Red panda wearing sunglasses
svg:

  <ellipse cx='48' cy='60.5' rx='1.6' ry='1.2' fill='#a86a52'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 66 Q50 71 45 72' stroke='#4a1a08' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 66 Q50 71 55 72' stroke='#4a1a08' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
